name: Ilyen Seret
source_profile: ● Ilyen Seret (N) is an archivist and historian. Ilyen is fascinated by reports of ancient dwarven works beneath the mountains. His research may eventually expose connections between the region's lost civilizations, although he currently has no knowledge of the illithid colony.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 70 (source excerpt; may be partial)
